claim: Other reported approaches include multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), CNN variants, and attention-based deep learning; one attention-based study compares input-, layer-, and decision-level fusion of optical and radar time series.
reason: S2 covers MLP and CNN variants on Sentinel-2 time series; S3 covers attention-based fusion of Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 at input, layer, and decision levels. But 'attention-based deep learning' is attributed to a study comparing fusion levels; S3 states that, so it is supported.
